name: bybit_cashcarry_shadow_v2_20260715
purpose: Durably collect and replay public Bybit spot/linear-perpetual observations with exact instrument receipts, common-quantity quantization, deterministic multi-level book walks, and conservative break-even refusal before any paper cycle opens.

entry_economics_gate.conservative_rate: minimum of projected rate and the required completed-settlement rates
required_coverage: round-trip deterministic walked spread and slippage

quantization_contract.quantity: same base quantity on spot and perp, floored to the least common quantity step
quantization_contract.minimums: both minOrderQty and min notional must pass
quantization_contract.price: every public level must align to tickSize; adverse limit guard rounds away from the trader
quantization_contract.depth: walk levels deterministically in exchange price priority

recovery_contract.journal: one JSONL record atomically contains normalized observation, v2 execution/economics decision, frozen-v1 step, and post-step open state
recovery_contract.integrity: strict sequence plus previous-record hash chain plus per-record checksum
recovery_contract.duplicate: identical observation is an idempotent no-op
recovery_contract.conflict: same symbol and observed timestamp with different payload fails closed
recovery_contract.restart: replay every observation and require byte-equivalent deterministic decision/state

evidence_gate.mechanics: focused deterministic tests plus restart/idempotency/corruption fixtures
evidence_gate.paper_cycles: at least 10 completed cycles diagnose mechanics only
evidence_gate.edge: at least 30 completed cycles across at least 3 liquid symbols with positive median and p25 net results under base and stress costs

known_remaining_blockers: v2 is a single-shot/replay library and runner; no daemon is preregistered or launched
frozen v1 receipts use equal USD notional per leg while v2 stores an executable common-base-quantity plan; exact receipt parity is intentionally not claimed
no account fee-tier receipt, balance, margin, liquidation, transfer, borrow, outage, or reconciliation model
no partial-fill recovery state machine because partial fills are refused before paper state mutation
public REST legs are non-atomic and are still subject to stale/skew refusal
a local hash chain cannot independently detect deletion of a valid terminal suffix without an external anchor
no evidence of positive edge and no permission to allocate capital
